cards.front: I want you to come to my birthday.
cards.back: Quiero que vengas a mi cumpleaños.

cards.front: I want you to meet my sister.
cards.back: Quiero que conozcas a mi hermana.

cards.front: I don't want you to leave yet.
cards.back: No quiero que te vayas todavía.

cards.front: I hope everything goes well.
cards.back: Espero que todo salga bien.

cards.front: I hope the weather is nice this weekend.
cards.back: Espero que haga buen tiempo este fin de semana.

cards.front: I hope it's not too late.
cards.back: Espero que no sea muy tarde.

cards.front: I hope we see each other again soon.
cards.back: Espero que nos volvamos a ver pronto.

cards.front: I'd rather you choose the restaurant.
cards.back: Prefiero que tú elijas el restaurante.

cards.front: I prefer that you drive.
cards.back: Prefiero que manejes tú.

cards.front: Hopefully it doesn't rain tomorrow.
cards.back: Ojalá no llueva mañana.

cards.front: Hopefully it arrives soon.
cards.back: Ojalá llegue pronto.

cards.front: Hopefully everything turns out well.
cards.back: Ojalá todo salga bien.

cards.front: Have a good day!
cards.back: ¡Que tengas un buen día!

cards.front: Get well soon!
cards.back: ¡Que te mejores!

cards.front: Have a good time!
cards.back: ¡Que lo pases bien!

cards.front: I'm glad you came.
cards.back: Me alegra que hayas venido.

cards.front: I'm glad you're here.
cards.back: Me alegro de que estés aquí.

cards.front: I'm glad you passed your exam.
cards.back: Me alegra que hayas aprobado el examen.

cards.front: I love that you cook for me.
cards.back: Me encanta que me cocines.

cards.front: I love that you always make me laugh.
cards.back: Me encanta que siempre me hagas reír.

cards.front: It bothers me that you're always late.
cards.back: Me molesta que siempre llegues tarde.

cards.front: It bothers me that the neighbors are so noisy.
cards.back: Me molesta que los vecinos hagan tanto ruido.

cards.front: It surprises me that you don't know that.
cards.back: Me sorprende que no lo sepas.

cards.front: It surprises me that he got the promotion.
cards.back: Me sorprende que le hayan dado el ascenso.

cards.front: I'm so sorry you can't come.
cards.back: Siento mucho que no puedas venir.

cards.front: I'm so sorry you're not feeling well.
cards.back: Siento mucho que no te sientas bien.

cards.front: I'm worried something might go wrong.
cards.back: Me preocupa que algo salga mal.

cards.front: I'm worried you might get lost.
cards.back: Me preocupa que te pierdas.

cards.front: It's a shame she can't be here.
cards.back: Es una pena que ella no pueda estar aquí.

cards.front: It's sad that they're moving away.
cards.back: Es triste que se vayan a mudar.

cards.front: I think she's coming. [fact — indicative]
cards.back: Creo que ella viene.

cards.front: I don't think she's coming. [doubt — subjunctive]
cards.back: No creo que ella venga.

cards.front: I don't think he's right.
cards.back: No creo que tenga razón.

cards.front: I don't think it's that expensive.
cards.back: No creo que sea tan caro.

cards.front: I doubt the team wins today.
cards.back: Dudo que el equipo gane hoy.

cards.front: I doubt this is going to work.
cards.back: Dudo que esto funcione.

cards.front: It's not true that she said that.
cards.back: No es verdad que ella haya dicho eso.

cards.front: It's possible it'll rain this afternoon.
cards.back: Es posible que llueva esta tarde.

cards.front: It's probable that he already knows.
cards.back: Es probable que ya lo sepa.

cards.front: Maybe this is the best option.
cards.back: Tal vez sea la mejor opción.

cards.front: Maybe he'll come later. [I believe he's coming — indicative]
cards.back: Creo que viene más tarde.

cards.front: Maybe he'll come later. [uncertain — subjunctive]
cards.back: Quizás venga más tarde.

cards.front: It's important that you know this.
cards.back: Es importante que sepas esto.

cards.front: It's important that we arrive on time.
cards.back: Es importante que lleguemos a tiempo.

cards.front: It's necessary that you go to the doctor.
cards.back: Es necesario que vayas al médico.

cards.front: It's better that we leave early.
cards.back: Es mejor que nos vayamos temprano.

cards.front: It's better that you stay home.
cards.back: Es mejor que te quedes en casa.

cards.front: You'd better pay attention.
cards.back: Más vale que pongas atención.

cards.front: You'd better hurry up.
cards.back: Más vale que te apures.

cards.front: It's a shame we can't be there.
cards.back: Es una lástima que no podamos estar ahí.

cards.front: It's ridiculous that it costs so much.
cards.back: Es ridículo que cueste tanto.

cards.front: It's normal that you're tired after working so much.
cards.back: Es normal que estés cansado después de trabajar tanto.

cards.front: It's fine that you rest a little.
cards.back: Está bien que descanses un poco.

cards.front: It's advisable that you do it as soon as possible.
cards.back: Conviene que lo hagas lo antes posible.

cards.front: I'm asking you to help me.
cards.back: Te pido que me ayudes.

cards.front: I'm asking you to call me later.
cards.back: Te pido que me llames más tarde.

cards.front: I recommend you rest.
cards.back: Te recomiendo que descanses.

cards.front: I suggest you try the tacos.
cards.back: Te sugiero que pruebes los tacos.

cards.front: I advise you to talk to him.
cards.back: Te aconsejo que hables con él.

cards.front: I advise you not to worry.
cards.back: Te aconsejo que no te preocupes.

cards.front: The boss asked Ana to write the report.
cards.back: El jefe le pidió a Ana que escribiera el informe.

cards.front: Tell her to call me.
cards.back: Dile que me llame.

cards.front: Ask him to explain it to you.
cards.back: Pídele que te lo explique.

cards.front: The teacher is asking us to do the homework.
cards.back: El profesor nos pide que hagamos la tarea.

cards.front: My mom is telling my brother to clean his room.
cards.back: Mi mamá le dice a mi hermano que limpie su cuarto.

cards.front: I'd rather you not buy me anything.
cards.back: Prefiero que no me compres nada.

cards.front: I'm speaking slowly so that you understand me.
cards.back: Hablo despacio para que me entiendas.

cards.front: I bought you this book so you'd read it.
cards.back: Te compré este libro para que lo leas.

cards.front: We're leaving early so that we arrive on time.
cards.back: Salimos temprano para que lleguemos a tiempo.

cards.front: I'm writing it down so you don't forget.
cards.back: Lo escribo para que no se te olvide.

cards.front: I'm turning down the music so the neighbors don't complain.
cards.back: Bajo la música para que los vecinos no se quejen.

cards.front: I'm telling you this before you leave.
cards.back: Te lo digo antes de que te vayas.

cards.front: We'll go out at night without our parents knowing.
cards.back: Saldremos de noche sin que nuestros padres lo sepan.

cards.front: I'll cut it in half so it's easier.
cards.back: Lo corto a la mitad para que sea más fácil.

cards.front: Let me know when you get home. [future — subjunctive]
cards.back: Avísame cuando llegues a casa.

cards.front: She called me when she got home. [past — indicative]
cards.back: Me llamó cuando llegó a casa.

cards.front: When you have time, come see me.
cards.back: Cuando tengas tiempo, ven a verme.

cards.front: When he arrives tomorrow, he'll call you.
cards.back: Cuando llegue mañana, te llamará.

cards.front: We ate when he arrived. [past — indicative]
cards.back: Comimos cuando llegó.

cards.front: When he arrives, we'll eat. [future — subjunctive]
cards.back: Cuando llegue, comeremos.

cards.front: I'll wait until you're ready.
cards.back: Te espero hasta que estés listo.

cards.front: Tell me before you leave.
cards.back: Dime antes de que te vayas.

cards.front: I'll leave as soon as the meeting ends.
cards.back: Me voy en cuanto termine la reunión.

cards.front: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor.
cards.back: Cuando sea grande, quiero ser médico.

cards.front: If I won the lottery, I'd travel the world.
cards.back: Si ganara la lotería, viajaría por el mundo.

cards.front: If I were you, I'd apologize.
cards.back: Si fuera tú, me disculparía.

cards.front: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.
cards.back: Si fuera tú, aceptaría la oferta.

cards.front: If I had more time, I'd exercise more.
cards.back: Si tuviera más tiempo, haría más ejercicio.

cards.front: If I had more money, I'd live in another city.
cards.back: Si tuviera más dinero, viviría en otra ciudad.

cards.front: If I could live anywhere, I'd live in Spain.
cards.back: Si pudiera vivir en cualquier lugar, viviría en España.

cards.front: If I could, I'd help you.
cards.back: Si pudiera, te ayudaría.

cards.front: If she called me, I'd answer.
cards.back: Si me llamara, contestaría.

cards.front: If we left earlier, we wouldn't be late.
cards.back: Si saliéramos más temprano, no llegaríamos tarde.

cards.front: She acts as if nothing happened.
cards.back: Actúa como si nada hubiera pasado.

cards.front: He talks as if he knew everything.
cards.back: Habla como si lo supiera todo.

cards.front: She spends money as if she were rich.
cards.back: Gasta dinero como si fuera rica.

cards.front: Even though it's raining, we're going. [fact — indicative]
cards.back: Aunque llueve, vamos.

cards.front: Even if it rains, we'll go. [unknown — subjunctive]
cards.back: Aunque llueva, vamos.

cards.front: I'm going to call you even if it's late.
cards.back: Te voy a llamar aunque sea tarde.

cards.front: I want to go out even if it's just for a little while.
cards.back: Quiero salir aunque sea un rato.

cards.front: I'll have a little cake even if it's just a tiny bit.
cards.back: Voy a comer pastel aunque sea un poquito.

cards.front: I want to see you even if it's only for the weekend.
cards.back: Quiero verte aunque sea solo por el fin de semana.

cards.front: We'll go out unless it's too cold.
cards.back: Saldremos a menos que haga demasiado frío.

cards.front: I'll be there unless something comes up.
cards.back: Estaré ahí a menos que surja algo.

cards.front: I have an apartment that has a balcony. [real — indicative]
cards.back: Tengo un apartamento que tiene balcón.

cards.front: I'm looking for an apartment that has a balcony. [might not exist — subjunctive]
cards.back: Busco un apartamento que tenga balcón.

cards.front: I'm looking for an apartment with two bedrooms.
cards.back: Busco un apartamento que tenga dos habitaciones.

cards.front: I need a car that doesn't cost too much.
cards.back: Necesito un auto que no cueste mucho.

cards.front: We need someone who speaks French.
cards.back: Necesitamos a alguien que hable francés.

cards.front: We need a president who is honest.
cards.back: Necesitamos un presidente que sea honesto.

cards.front: There's nobody who knows as much as her.
cards.back: No hay nadie que sepa tanto como ella.

cards.front: I don't know anyone who can help me.
cards.back: No conozco a nadie que pueda ayudarme.

cards.front: I mean, you're not coming?
cards.back: O sea, ¿no vas a venir?

cards.front: I have to finish this no matter what.
cards.back: Tengo que terminar esto sea como sea.

cards.front: Whatever it may be, I want to know the truth.
cards.back: Sea lo que sea, quiero saber la verdad.

cards.front: We can eat whatever.
cards.back: Podemos comer lo que sea.

cards.front: Whatever happens, I'll be here.
cards.back: Pase lo que pase, estaré aquí.

cards.front: We can meet whenever you want.
cards.back: Podemos vernos cuando quieras.

cards.front: Let's go wherever you want.
cards.back: Vamos donde quieras.

cards.front: Do it however you want.
cards.back: Hazlo como quieras.
